notes.title: Version 5.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

The latest update features the [b]Global Chat[/b] which is the newest addition to the game. The chat is accessible in the Custom Games screen, as well as in the Lobby and In game. The amount of players which are currently in the Custom Games Lobby will be displayed as well as the amount of players currently in a room.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32678967/6ffed30e4794ae3012b083c1151fcc6db634899d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32678967/534aa206c6011fcc4e178af5d1ade2cd403823f7.png[/img][/url]
(click on Thumbnail for a higher resolution)

I hope this will help to find others for a game. Consider joining the discord server created by one of the players (https://discord.gg/Kr6YQd3) to find others more easily for a game.


[b]Further improvements:[/b]

Fixed a Bug where the game would be unresponsive when a connection to the server could not be established.

[b]Update 5.0a:[/b]
Fixed an asyncron issue with the quick discard
Fixed a softlock issue
Added 32 bit support

notes.title: Version 4.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes version 4.0[/h1]

Version 4.0 has been released which includes the Yaku helper. The yaku helper is a new feature which acts as a guideline on how to progress your hand. It will show you how many tiles you are away from a certain yaku and gives you a preview on the tiles you need to complete it.

The yaku helper can be opened / closed with the question mark button in the top right corner.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32678967/4e4afd5f49eef6be57e25feedb0790956e8efdf4.png[/img]

Once activated, a sidebar will show up which includes most yakus and a cross reference with your current hand. Riichi and luck based yakus (e.g ippatsu) are not included. Suu ankou is also not included.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32678967/b9bd2d21cd3f78c25cdb4d59d45933b1d1053591.png[/img]

It will also show you the current shanten of your hand and a list of suggested discards which will progress your hand. Note that it is the same logic as the NPC works with.

In case a yaku cannot be achieved anymore (open hand, insufficient live tiles,...) the yaku will be labeled as "unavailable".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32678967/b29061b2105a9516ab3023e170226fd0533cbe06.png[/img]

Please note that the yaku helper is not perfect and its primarily function is to act as a guideline for new players. The preview of the final hand will, for the most part, not take into account the tiles left in the wall (exceptions are honor-based yakus like Dai Sangen (Big Three Dragons)).

You might experience lag during the calculation, particularly if the whole hand is closed and consists of one suit. In that case, close the yaku helper as the calculation will be disabled while being closed. Code improvements will follow with time.


[b]Further Improvements:[/b]

[list]
    [*]Skip Animation has been moved from game-based to player-based and is now an option in the player settings under the "Game" tab.
[*]Various Code Improvements
[/list]

[b]Update 4.0a[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed a softlock after calling a tile in certain situations
[/list] 

[b]Update 4.0b[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed a bug where the Tsumo button would not show up after a successful rinshan kaihou.
[*]Graphic images on tiles are now updated correctly on opponents hands when playing with Training Mode.
[*]Updated the tiles indicators to be more easily readable
[/list] 

[b]Update 4.0c[/b]
[list]
 [*]Added background music
[*]Added an additional volume slider which separates music and sound effects
[*]Fixed an issue where tile graphics were not updated when playing in training mode.
[*]Reworked the display in the middle of the table
[/list]

[b]Update 4.0c1[/b]
[list]
 [*]Added 1440p and 2160p (4k) support (16:9)
[*]Fixed a visual error of SuuKantsu being displayed as closed hand only in the yaku list.
[/list]

[b]Update 4.0d[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed an issue where the Avatar of strangers would not be loaded the first time
[*]Implemented an option for Quick Discard (drawn tile) / Quick Pass with Right Mouseclick / double left click in the options menu. In case you make a call and use Quick Discard afterwards, the first valid tile for discard will be used in case Tile Shift is not allowed
[*] Implemented a gap between the live wall and the dead wall
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.0
notes.content:
Version 3.0 has been released which includes the following:

[list]
    [*]Animated Background Art
    [*]Improved AI
    [*]Several Bugfixes
 [*]New design for settings
[*]New in game design
[/list] 

The AI now has 3 configurations:
[list]
    [*]None (Tsumogiri)
    [*]Easy (Old AI)
    [*]Standard (New improved AI)
[/list] 

The new improved AI (standard) is capable of declaring Riichi when in Tenpai and knows how to defend against Riichi. It will play careful or risky depending on the current rank based on points. The AI can be modified in the "settings" menu with a new tab called "Game". A disconnected player will not get taken over by it.

[b]Update 3.0a[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added more achievements
  [*]Fixed an issue where the call duration bar was shown in the wrong color for the east player
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0b[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a softlock bug if the round ends in a draw caused by 3.0a
[*]Fixed another call duration bar color issue
  [*]Implemented touch-screen support (Experimental)
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0c[/b]
[list]
    [*]Small Bugfixes
[/list] 


[b]Update 3.0d[/b]
[list]
    [*]Code improvement, the game takes now less CPU and GPU.
  [*]Fixed a bug where the steam avatar of strangers would not be loaded the first time they joined the lobby
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0e[/b]
[list]
    [*]New design for settings (audio, video, quality and game settings)
  [*]Default texture is now displayed correctly as preview in the profile menu
[/list] 

The new settings / options menu has now a more variety (vsync, antialiasing, etc.). You can also disable the background animation to further reduce the cpu.

[b]Update 3.0e1[/b]
[list]
    [*]Combo list is not blurred anymore with a lower texture quality
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0f[/b]
[list]
    [*]Npc avatars are now shown correctly
 [*]Fixed a softlock when reconnecting during the points calculation
[*]Chat is now darker when focused
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0f1[/b]
[list]
    [*]Implemented dark black tiles
 [*]Fixed an issue where the riichi tile would overlap after a reconnect
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0f2[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a softlock when the player presses Pass during his turn in case of a closed kan
[/list] 

[b]Update 3.0f3[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a softlock after the npc declares a kan when skip animations is enabled.
[*]Fixed a problem where tenpai would not be registered in certain situations.
[/list] 


[b]Update 3.0f4[/b]
[list]
    [*]Performance optimizations
[*]AI optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
Version 2.0 has been released which includes the reconnect feature. A player who lost connection and / or got thrown out of the game for any reason can reconnect at any stage of the game. The time for reconnecting takes about 5 seconds in average, but please allow up to 30 seconds. If you reconnect during the points calculation, you have to wait until the start of the next round.
In case a player tries to reconnect to a game which already ended, the player will get notified accordingly.

Further fixes / improvements:
[list]
    [*]Fixed a problem with Itsu detection
    [*]Fixed an incorrect minipoints calculation bug
    [*]Players will get notified in game if another player disconnected or is currently reconnecting
[/list] 

[b]Update 2.0a[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a black screen Bug upon starting the game after the update
[/list] 

[b]Update 2.0b[/b]
[list]
    [*]Thirteen orphans and seven pairs softlock fix
 [*]Fixed a Bug where the player was unable to discard a tile after a closed kan
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.1
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

    [*]Fixed a bug where Riichi alone was not registered as a valid yaku.

    [*]Fixed a bug where the player was still in temporary furiten at the end of his turn
    [*]Fixed a bug where edge waits were not calculated correctly
 [*]Attempt to fix a bug where called tiles did not match a valid chi / pon for some players (rare case).
[/list] 

Steam achievements caused the game to crash, this issue is currently investigated. Once it is resolved, the achievements will be activated again.

The highlighted tiles caused some strange artifacts on MacOS X. There is an option to disable the "tile highlights" in the settings menu (ingame top right corner / startscreen options menu). This is due to a shader problem which will be investigated.
